title: The light switch: the 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine
chapters: Step 3: how deep light goes (toy model)

questions.prompt: How much faster than a human eye does the alga react to light?

reply.0: Not quite: the Nobel Committee says it is more than twenty times faster.
reply.1: Closer, but the Nobel Committee says more than twenty times faster.
reply.2: Yes. The Nobel Committee says: more than twenty times faster, about half a millisecond after light reaches its eyespot.

questions.prompt: In our toy model, which colour of light reaches deepest into brain tissue?

reply.0: Blue fades fastest in our toy model.
reply.1: Yellow goes further than blue, but not furthest.
reply.2: Red, in our toy model. It ignores absorption outside blood, so read every depth as rough.

questions.prompt: In our toy model, how many neurons can one degree of warming recruit with blue light?

reply.0: Far more, in our toy model.
reply.1: More than that, in our toy model.
reply.2: More than ten thousand, in our toy model with its assumptions: one threshold, one expression law.
